topic.title: Why no one is using encoder-decoder models ?
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content: Hi was going through the code and all the shared code is around some ranker model. Why no one is training a encoder decoder based model?

comments.content: Do you you mean a spectrum2SMILES model? Generated SMILES might not be valid, while ranker models always choose valid ones.

replies.content: how can ranker models rank novel structures tho? if the inchikey14 is not present in available datasets?
yes, spectrum 2 smiles. the shared code by the organizers have an encoder decoder architecture
also can we generate the output through the model and then validate that compound is valid and then only give our top candidates something like this.
